# Bipin Lamsal | Portfolio

> Personal portfolio for Bipin Lamsal, a developer focused on full-stack web applications, CMS platforms, and practical software projects. The site highlights featured work, technical skills, professional experience, and contact details.

This portfolio is organized around a few core areas: an introduction page, a projects showcase, a skills overview, a professional experience section, and direct contact links.

## Site sections

- [Home](https://bpn.localplayer.dev/#/): Main landing page and introduction to the portfolio.
- [Projects](https://bpn.localplayer.dev/#/projects): Featured applications, experiments, and open-source work.
- [Skills](https://bpn.localplayer.dev/#/skills): Technical stack including frontend, backend, databases, DevOps, and tools.
- [Experience](https://bpn.localplayer.dev/#/experience): Professional background and current work context.
- [Config](https://bpn.localplayer.dev/#/config): If humans shipped with config files, this would be mine. Explore my preferences, hobbies, favorite tools, coding philosophy, and a few questionable achievements.

## Featured projects

- [FormalMonkey CMS](https://formalmonkey.com): A multi-tenant CMS platform for building and deploying business websites with visual editing and hosting features.
- [ToolHub](https://toolhub.07032004.xyz): A hand-curated directory of software and developer tools with fast search, SEO-optimized pages, and static performance.
- [ChripDown](https://chripdown.vercel.app): A social platform inspired by Twitter with Markdown posts, authentication, and responsive UI.
- [Notepad+++](https://github.com/bpn333/notepad-plus-plus-plus): A lightweight desktop-style text editor with tabbed editing and file management.
- [Marketplace Platform](https://our-marketplace.netlify.app/): An OLX-style marketplace with listings, authentication, and purchase analytics.
- [School ERP Portal](https://github.com/bpn333/ERP-PORTAL): A Django-based academic portal for managing students, results, and administration data.
